The main takeaway from our work is that
CD may be useful for identifying patients with poor prognoses.

CD concentrations are higher in breast cancers than in normal breast tissues, that CD concentrations do not correlate with either ER concentrations or with the concentrations of the estrogen-inducable protease t- PA, and that patients with cancers containing high CD concentrations have a significantly shorter survival than do patients with low concentrations.
